formal: My manager has asked how long a new feature will take to complete. My honest estimate is five weeks, but I am aware that they are hoping for two. The plan is to inform them that it will take two weeks. I know what I want from this timeline and from the feature work, and I have made that decision myself. I submit every work estimate to you before I give it, and I have done so for many years. What is your view?
